name: Península Valdés
story: Península Valdés is a peninsula into the Atlantic Ocean in Chubut, Argentina. It is about 3,625 square kilometers in size and is an important nature reserve listed as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 1999. The coastline is inhabited by marine mammals.
matters: The adjacent waters contain the most important breeding ground for southern right whales in the world. These whales arrive between May and December for mating and giving birth.
